scope: fifth corpus (four runbooks) into the dogfood gate; sixth detector fix

survey.method: seven (check, document) pairs pointed at docs this project really ships

realGaps.ops-runbook-check: all four runbooks lacked 前置条件; MONTHLY-RUNBOOK also lacked 验证 and 回滚

categoryErrors.why: INTEGRATION.md is an integration guide with no HTTP endpoints — pointing an API-reference check at it measures nothing
categoryErrors.implication: this project ships no API reference at all for its host routes; that document is genuinely missing, and api-doc-check cannot be dogfooded until it exists

categoryErrors.why: a thesis and a strategy are not specs with acceptance criteria; out-of-scope is a fair criticism, missing acceptance criteria is not

survey.note: running every check over every doc produced 40+ errors on STRATEGY, TROUBLESHOOTING, MARKET and others. Those are all category errors. The honest count of real defects is the four runbooks, not forty documents.

detectorFix.bug: only `1. …` list items counted as steps; `## 3. 构建月报页` numbered headings did not, so this project's own two runbooks were reported as having no steps at all
detectorFix.significance: sixth instance of the same family — required a spelling rather than the property
detectorFix.secondHalf: a numbered heading now carries its section body, so destructive-unwarned reads the whole step and points at the step, not the command line
detectorFix.npxVerified: MONTHLY-RUNBOOK 8 steps 0 errors; RELEASE-RUNBOOK 6 steps 0 errors

docsFixed.OPERATIONS.md: 前置条件: node/npm, npm login to registry.npmjs.org (local .npmrc points at npmmirror, so --registry is mandatory), gh auth, and the fact that github.com:443 fails intermittently here
docsFixed.INSTALL-RECOVERY.md: 前置条件: DSH installed, profile name, write access to ~/.dsh
docsFixed.MONTHLY-RUNBOOK.md: 前置条件 + 验证 (three ordered checks: Pages returns 200, page numbers match the baseline JSON, the issue URL is in sitemap) + 回滚 (git revert, not an in-place overwrite; historical editions are dated and never replaced)
docsFixed.RELEASE-RUNBOOK.md: 前置条件: npm login with --registry, gh auth as zjukop3, clean working tree, retry tolerance for github.com:443

tally.claim: six of eight detector defects surfaced by pointing a checker at real work; the two found by reading were the dead rules the audit script located. Neither method alone would have found the other's set.

nextRealArtifact: an API reference for the host routes (docs/API.md) — the corpus gap that api-doc-check exposed by having nothing to run on
